ABOUT LEGIONS

We are an independent game development studio founded in 2024. Based in Azerbaijan, we are a small team focused predominantly on horror games, aiming to deliver realistic and terrifying visuals.

In the future, we aim to focus on online horror games — creating experiences that draw you in with compelling stories, immerse you in fear, and offer rich, atmospheric gameplay. Our goal is to develop games that you can enjoy both solo and with friends, creating engaging and memorable experiences.

Core Features

  • •Online multiplayer for 2-4 players
  • •Story-driven horror experiences
  • •High-quality graphics with strong, immersive atmosphere

OUR GAMES

Don't Panic Together

Released

Don’t Panic Together is an online co-op psychological horror game with a microphone detection system. Players explore dark forest locations, collect important items, and complete objectives together. But panic, screams, and loud noises can quickly lead to death.

Play NowLearn More

Trust Me

Coming soon

Survive with your friends in a wasteland devastated by an atomic bomb, explore dangerous areas, and strengthen yourself by collecting and selling valuable loot. Upgrade your gear and your vehicle with the money you earn, and push into farther and deadlier zones. Explore, loot, and survive!
